title: Testing and Validating a Migration knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Testing and Validating a Migration?
options: migration depends on the old version, new build integration and browser support requirements
It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
questions.answer_key: migration depends on the old version, new build integration and browser support requirements
questions.explanation: Testing and Validating a Migration is best understood through the syllabus topics: Comparing the old and new pages, Checking component states, Verifying responsive layouts. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with testing and validating a migration?
options: Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
work in a branch, follow the official upgrade guide and compare representative pages
questions.answer_key: work in a branch, follow the official upgrade guide and compare representative pages
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Comparing the old and new pages, Checking component states, Verifying responsive layouts, Testing custom styles and plugins.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying testing and validating a migration?
options: Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
do not mix v3 and v4 directives or configurations without a migration plan
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
questions.answer_key: do not mix v3 and v4 directives or configurations without a migration plan
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
